name: Fleet Admiral
source:
[url=/c22166]Kayto[/url] and [url=/c22170]Maray’s[/url] pet dog.

He is a very high ranking officer of the Cera Space Force, outranking even commissioned star ship captains.

However, he seems content to live his life one stroll through the park at a time.
